title: Losing teeth, dentures and playing again
summary: Lewis tells of having teeth pulled in New York, getting dentures put in immediately, and returning to play within days.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians
